description: This Java source file defines the 'AclNotAllowedException' class, a specific runtime exception indicating that a Thing's JSON schema version does not permit Access Control List (ACL) modifications. The class is annotated with deprecation and immutability annotations and contains methods for creating instances from messages, JSON, and with specific headers. It also includes builder support for constructing instances.

classes.name: AclNotAllowedException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a Thing's JSON schema version does not permit Access Control List modifications. It extends DittoRuntimeException and provides static methods for instantiation and a builder pattern for customization.

classes.name: AclNotAllowedException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of AclNotAllowedException with a fluent API, allowing setting of message, description, cause, href, and headers.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance initializing context for a specific Thing ID.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an AclNotAllowedException from a specific message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AclNotAllowedException by parsing a JSON object and applying given headers.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions supported by this exception type, in this case only version 1.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the exception with the specified headers.
